Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a peptidomics study focusing on proteasome-catalyzed peptide splicing (PCPS). While it discusses the immunopeptidome as the biological context, the actual assay is an in vitro digestion of synthetic polypeptides. The acquisition is DDA (Top Speed mode). No PTMs were searched. The 'Top-down proteomics' tag in PRIDE metadata is likely a misclassification as the methods describe LC-MS/MS of digested peptides (bottom-up/peptidomics logic).

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is highly specialized, focusing on the identification of spliced peptides (non-templated) rather than standard protein identification. Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail to identify the spliced products as they are non-contiguous. The analysis requires a de novo sequencing approach followed by a splicing algorithm to map fragments back to the precursor polypeptide.
